name: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd.
summary: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd. operates as a leading international provider of artificial intelligence data solutions. The company delivers specialized data products and services to enterprises and academic institutions across the globe. Their offerings encompass crucial AI domains like speech recognition, computer vision, natural language processing, and lexicon, alongside comprehensive data lifecycle services including data design, collection, transcription, and annotation. Their clientele spans a wide range, from technology companies and AI development firms to scientific research organizations. Established in 2005, the company is headquartered in Beijing, China.
